But the demand signal has decayed hard. The coin is down 88% from its 30-minute high and 88% over 30 minutes. Recommendation: no buy. The case for it rests on early breadth that has since reversed, and nothing in the brief shows buying pressure that would survive the 30-60 minute window after a 30-second execution delay and 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs.
